title: Can’t process the MePay
body: I cannot process my incoming MePay transfer on this new app. Please update it. I had to re download the old app and process the MePay. My MePay configuration never went through.
author: lentt99

reply.body:
Thank you for your feedback and taking time to write to us with regards to your concern. 
To assist you further on this, kindly send in your details to mobilebankingdev@emiratesnbd.com from your registered email id. We assure you a response within 1 working day.

title: Clueless on 2 transactions on new app
body: Did 2 payments using new app, transactions were completed.  Money is not deducted from account still, called the call center they are clueless about the transactions, will it be deducted later !
author: MATK84

reply.body:
Dear MATK84, we would like to understand what went wrong. 
Please get in touch with mobilebankingdev@emiratesnbd.com or use the "send a bug" feature in the message area so we will be able to investigate the issue and support you. Thanks!
